scope: A curated starter set of public AI monk avatar profiles. This is not a complete census of social accounts.
methodology: Include a synthetic monk persona only when a platform/creator disclosure or credible reporting supports that classification. Keep screenshot-only cases marked unverified.
Do not merge accounts on similar names alone. Unknown handles, creators, launch dates, and product URLs remain null with a reason.

Store platform, source URL, capture date, and metric beside each number. Instagram followers, YouTube subscribers, views, seller counters, creator statements, orders, and net profit are different measures.
Summarize video structure without storing full scripts, captions, or downloaded media. Video URLs point to the original platform.
User-provided screenshots are identified as such; their calendar capture date is unknown unless the screenshot itself shows it.
